text:
The Willow planning meetings (3–10 Nov) covered 26 modules. Corrected values include catalog ttl_s 390, session ttl_s 330, upload batch_size 700, scheduler max_workers 14 and batch_size 400, reports max_workers 14, gateway ttl_s 180, metrics timeout_s 55, and auth ttl_s 240.

Ownership: audit, ingest, and quota belong to worker gamma, search, billing, and sync to delta, and shipping to alpha. Dependency rules forbid any path from archive to media, reports to scheduler, pricing to reports, or gateway to indexer. Client requirements set archive queue_depth to 450, quota max_workers to 20, ingest max_workers to 16, and search batch_size to 400. The rollout needs shipping and session ahead of indexer. The security review is at month end. Linters, Rust rewrites, and runbook updates were deferred.
